goal: Cut over Android universe endpoint to fixed HTTPS gateway and verify bearer->cookie transition with lifecycle-stable E2E evidence.

inputs.description: Android worker canonical root inside the same Narrative_Loop repository.
Optional local Android Studio workspace alias path.

constraints.notes: Execute Android-side work from android/NarrativeLoopMobile (same repository canonical path). If using a local Android Studio workspace alias path, report both paths in evidence. Any permission elevation or destructive command requires explicit User approval.

acceptance: Android uses gateway URL for first bearer-authenticated request.
Cookie-based follow-up requests succeed without fallback regression.
401/403 behavior and lifecycle stability are validated with reproducible evidence.

risk.note: WebView cookie/session handling differences may break staging auth behavior.

next_actions: Submit result.json with E2E logs and reproducible checklist output.
Escalate immediately if gateway endpoint or token contract mismatch is detected.
Provide handoff-ready evidence for CT strict decision.

metadata.domain: Ingest and Auth Gateway / Mobile Client Contract
